description:
[read-only] The ad network's health report for one of the brand's Meta ad accounts (`adAccountId` from ads_accounts_list): overall ok / attention / blocked, and checks for account status, payment, spending cap, Page, Instagram, lead terms and pixel, each problem with its fix link. Read-only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/accounts/health.)

adAccountId.description: A Meta ad account id (act_123 or 123).

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key is pinned to its brand and any other value is 403.

name: ads_account_health
title: Ad account health
